reasoning.step1:
1) Document classification
- Presence of "Facture transporteur", "Facture", "Montant TTC", line items and totals → clearly an invoice.
- No exclusion keywords ("Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung", etc.) prominent → proceed with extraction.

2) Locate invoice date
- "Date: 06/03/2023" appears on pages 1–4. Conclusion: Invoice.Date = "06/03/2023".

3) Locate sender VAT ID
- Text shows "N° IDENTIFIANT T.V.A. : FR 47 546 650 334" and later "Votre n° ID TVA :FR 47546650334".
- Do not normalize/infer beyond source text. Choose the explicit sender VAT line: Sender.VatId = "FR 47 546 650 334".

4) Determine grand total and net amounts
- Multiple summaries show "TP total EUR 8.200,00" and overall totals "8.200,00" and "Net 8.200,00".
- Commas indicate decimal separator in source; preserve numeric value and decimals exactly.
- GrandTotal.Amount = 8200.00 (from "8.200,00").
- Net.Amount = 8200.00 (from "Net 8.200,00").

5) Determine VAT rate and VAT amount
- Tax section shows code A: "Net d'impôts" and line "Montant TVA EUR 0,00" and text "T01) Recettes nationales non imposables".
- VAT appears not applied; Vat.Amount = 0.00.
- No explicit VAT percentage rate present for the invoice (only tax code/notes) → Vat.Rate = "" (leave empty per No Inference).

6) Consistency checks
- Grand total equals Net.Amount (8200.00) and VAT zero — consistent with "non imposables" note.
- All extracted values map directly to explicit text; no guessing or normalization applied beyond numeric conversion.

7) Fields to output (final JSON will contain)
- GrandTotal.Amount: 8200.00
- Invoice.Date: "06/03/2023"
- Sender.VatId: "FR 47 546 650 334"
- Vat.Rate: ""
- Net.Amount: 8200.00
- Vat.Amount: 0.00
reasoning.step2:
GrandTotal.Amount — Confidence: 95%
- Evidence: Multiple explicit occurrences: "TP total EUR 8.200,00", "Net 8.200,00", totals shown as "8.200,00" and final invoice summary lines. Consistent across pages. Small OCR risk on separators → minor uncertainty.

Invoice.Date — Confidence: 99%
- Evidence: "Date: 06/03/2023" appears clearly on page headers on multiple pages. Very direct.

Sender.VatId — Confidence: 90%
- Evidence: Two explicit VAT strings: "N° IDENTIFIANT T.V.A. : FR 47 546 650 334" and "Votre n° ID TVA :FR 47546650334". Chose the spaced format as printed. OCR spacing could vary; content unambiguous.

Vat.Rate — Confidence: 85%
- Evidence: No explicit percentage present. Tax section indicates "Net d'impôts" and "Recettes nationales non imposables" implying no VAT rate applies. Decision to leave empty follows No Inference rule; confidence lowered by possibility of a hidden/abbreviated rate elsewhere in OCR.

Net.Amount — Confidence: 95%
- Evidence: Clearly indicated "Net 8.200,00" and matches TP total; consistent on multiple pages. Minor OCR separator risk.

Vat.Amount — Confidence: 98%
- Evidence: Tax table shows "Montant TVA EUR 0,00" and note "non imposables". Explicit zero VAT amount; high confidence.
